Indicator 1a measures the proportion of newly diagnosed adult patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) who undergo a colonoscopy, a critical step for accurate diagnosis and disease classification. Data from the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] compares performance across national, regional, and departmental levels for the 2023/24 period against the previous 2022/23 year [^src1].

Nationally, Denmark achieved an 80% compliance rate (1,917 out of 2,406 patients) in 2023/24, a marginal increase from 79% (1,923 out of 2,441 patients) in 2022/23, though it still missed the quality target (marked as "Nej") [^src1]. At the regional level, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] led the regions with an 89% success rate (278/312), followed by [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] at 84% (166/198) and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] at 81% (484/598), all of which met their targets ("Ja") [^src1]. Conversely, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] (77%) and [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] (75%) missed the target [^src1].

At the departmental level, performance varies drastically, often correlating with patient volume. Bornholm Medicinsk Afdeling was the absolute leader, achieving a 100% rate (21/21 patients), up from 88% the previous year [^src1]. HOL Holbæk Med. Gastroenterologi also performed exceptionally well at 94% (48/51) [^src1]. On the other end of the spectrum, Rigshospitalet Sygd. i Fordøjelsessystem, C (associated with [[rigshospitalet-med-klinik-mave-tarm-lever|Rigshospitalet Med. Klinik Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd.]]) was the trailer, recording only 58% (7/12 patients), though this was an improvement from 43% in 2022/23 [^src1]. [[hvidovre-gastroenheden|Hvidovre Gastroenheden]] also struggled significantly, achieving only 63% (139/221 patients) despite a much larger patient cohort [^src1]. Meanwhile, [[herlev-mave-tarm-leversygd|Herlev Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd.]] successfully met the target, achieving an 84% rate (155/184 patients) [^src1].

Several departments showed notable trends between the two periods. Nordsjælland Kirurgisk Afdeling saw a sharp decline, dropping from 87% (97/111) in 2022/23 to 79% (110/139) in 2023/24, causing them to miss the target [^src1]. In contrast, OUH Svendborg Medicinsk Afdeling improved from 68% (48/71) to 73% (56/77) [^src1]. Outliers in the data are heavily influenced by small denominators; for instance, Rigshospitalet's 58% and SHS Tønder Medicinsk Daghospital's 88% (7/8 patients) reflect very small sample sizes compared to high-volume centers like Aarhus Lever-, Mave- og Tarmsygd., which handled 163 patients but only achieved a 68% rate [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner andelen af nydiagnosticerede voksne med IBD, der har fået koloskopi, på lands-, regions- og afdelingsniveau for perioden 2023/24 og 2022/23, og viser en generel stigning i flere afdelinger men stadig betydelig regional variation.
